label: PF Backlog 455
title: PF: optimistic delivery lane (parallel push+PR; serialized landing; rebase->fast re-verify->merge)
body:
Child of the parallel-run-engine epic. Optimistic, developer-style delivery: parallel push+PR, serial only
at landing.

Scope: (1) on complete: release the item lease, enqueue a delivery run (ASYNC lane); (2) delivery lane: push the
feature branch + open PR in parallel; when green, if behind develop -> rebase -> FAST re-verify -> merge
(--no-ff) -> push develop -> backlog.set_delivery(branch, merge_sha, pr, pr_url) + set_status(completed);
(3) on gate failure/conflict -> status blocked/verifying + defect; (4) reuse core/vcs (merge/push/sync),
core/github (create_pr/ci_status), validation_engine FEATURE_PR (promotion merge-to-develop), pr_gate/merge_gate;
(5) only the landing (ref update) is serialized - per integration branch.

Out of scope: per-item assignment (C1), validation isolation (C2).

Descriptors: module:core/vcs.py; module:core/github.py; module:core/validation_engine.py;
module:api/routers/engineering.py; test:test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_optimistic_delivery.py.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; precheck --full green (39 gates); wired-audit + invocation-audit green; new test_delivery.py (3 tests). New core/delivery.py orchestrator: push+PR (github.create_pr, degrades without gh) -> validate (feature_pr) -> serialized landing (rebase -> fast re-verify -> merge --no-ff -> push) -> set_delivery + completed; failure -> blocked. Async trigger on assignment complete (BackgroundTask) + scripts/dev/deliver.py recovery runner.

dashboard_impact.reason: Operator surface is /wg status + the PF API (assignments view); the dashboard is a separate surface and stays out of this slice
